localizedValues.name: Beach Shelter
localizedValues.description:
Groups MUST contact the park in advance at (360) 344-4412 for a Special Activity Permit for weddings over 20 people and special equipment (i.e. canopies, dunk tanks, inflatable bouncer toys, climbing walls, or similar items).
The Beach Shelter is set amongst the primary sand dune on the beach at Fort Worden State Park. Outside of the shelter there is immediate beach access and commanding views of the Puget Sound and Whidbey Island. Amenities inside the shelter include a six burner range, refrigerator with small freezer, metal counter top and sink, three electrical outlets, and eight large picnic tables. Outside there are three picnic tables, a large charcoal grill and a group fire ring. The only heat source inside the shelter is a wood stove; the customer must provide wood. Collection of drift wood and branches is not allowed. The shelter hours are 9:00 Am to 30 minutes before dusk.
